reconstructed_text: Let ι be a finite type and E a real inner-product space. For every function f : E → ℝ, point w : E, finite family of directions directions : ι → E, family diagonal : ι → ℝ, and scalar laplacian : ℝ, assume that ‖w‖ = 1; every directions(i) is orthogonal to w; w is a global minimizer of f on the unit sphere {z ∈ E : ‖z‖ = 1}; for every i, the curve t ↦ f(unitSphereExp w (t • directions(i))) is continuous at t = 0; diagonal(i) equals deriv (deriv (t ↦ f(unitSphereExp w (t • directions(i))))) 0; and laplacian = ∑_i diagonal(i). Then 0 ≤ laplacian.
